meta.description: DQ expectations for Silver (cleansed, conformed) tables. Silver enforces business rules that Bronze does not. Thresholds use mostly=0.99 as a starting point — tune to your domain's actual null rates after profiling.
meta.when_to_run: After Silver write (post-transformation, pre-Gold promotion). Block Gold load if suite fails.

meta.notes: Silver table must have at least one row. Tune max_value to alert on volume spikes.
Replace 'business_key' with your actual primary key column. Silver must have no null business keys — quarantine or drop nulls in transformation.
Silver business key must be unique. If this is a slowly-changing table, scope uniqueness to (business_key, valid_from) instead.
All Silver rows must have a modification timestamp for SCD and audit purposes.
Reject timestamps before year 2000 — likely epoch-zero or default values from upstream.
Accepted status values — expand for your domain. This blocks unknown status codes from reaching Gold.
Status must always be populated after Silver transformation.
Email format validation. mostly=0.99 allows 1% slack for legacy records. Tighten to 1.0 once backfill is clean.
